NUMBER:

AUTHOR:
Marcus Aurelius
 (121–180)
 
QUOTATION:
Though thou be destined to live three thousand years and as many myriads besides, yet remember that no man loseth other life than that which he liveth, nor liveth other than that which he loseth.
 
ATTRIBUTION:
Meditations. ii. 14.
